raw_text: The Dangerous Game of Military Deepfakes: How a Fabricated Army Chief Video Nearly Escalated India-Pakistan Tensions. A deepfake video depicting the Indian Army Chief making threatening statements about Pakistan was circulated from accounts traced to Pakistani IP ranges, initially broadcast as genuine by Pakistani media outlets. Digital forensics revealed face-swap technology with detectable lip-sync artifacts. The incident highlights the dangerous potential of deepfakes to escalate tensions between nuclear-armed neighbours.
clean_text: The Wire reports on deepfake Army Chief video from Pakistani accounts that nearly escalated India-Pakistan tensions. Face-swap with lip-sync artifacts detected. Highlights deepfake danger between nuclear-armed states.
